SELECT -- 计划基本信息 pp.id as planId, pp.plan_code as planCode, pp.plan_start_time as planStartTime, pp.plan_end_time as planEndTime, pp.plan_status as planStatus, pp.start_location_name as startLocationName, pp.end_location_name as endLocationName, pp.boarding_time as boardingTime, pp.leaving_time as leavingTime, pp.notes,
-- 船舶信息 v.name_zh as vesselNameZh, v.name_en as vesselNameEn, v.vessel_call_sign as vesselCallSign, v.vessel_length as vesselLength, v.vessel_width as vesselWidth, v.gross_tonnage as grossTonnage, v.nationality as nationality, v.net_tonnage as netTonnage, v.deadweight as deadWeight, v.nationality,
-- 航次信息 voy.voyage_number as voyageNumber, voy.voyage_type as voyageType, voy.eta, voy.etd,
-- 代理信息 a.company_name as agentName, a.contact_person as agentContact, a.phone as agentPhone,
-- 引航员信息 pilot.pilot_name as mainPilot, pilot.phone as pilotPhone, pilot.short_number as pilotShortNum,
-- 驾驶员信息 driver.name as driverName, driver.phone as driverPhone, driver.license_number as licenseNumber,
-- 车辆信息 vehicle.license_plate as licensePlate, vehicle.vehicle_model as vehicleModel, vehicle.vehicle_status as vehicleStatus,
-- 拖轮分配信息（使用GROUP_CONCAT聚合） ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.tugboat_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM plan_tugboat_assignments pta INNER JOIN tugboats t ON pta.tugboat_id = t.id WHERE pta.plan_id = pp.id AND pta.status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') ) as tugboats,
-- 引航艇分配信息（使用GROUP_CONCAT聚合） ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pb.boat_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM plan_pilot_boat_assignments ppba INNER JOIN pilot_boats pb ON ppba.pilot_boat_id = pb.id WHERE ppba.plan_id = pp.id AND ppba.status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') ) as pilotBoats,
-- 确认统计信息（从分配表统计CONFIRMED状态） ( -- 注意：MySQL 中派生表( FROM ( ... ) temp ) 默认不支持引用外层查询别名 pp（除非使用 LATERAL）。 -- 这里改为“各分配表确认数求和”，语义等价且兼容性更好。 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_pilot_assignments WHERE plan_id = pp.id AND status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_driver_assignments WHERE plan_id = pp.id AND status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_tugboat_assignments WHERE plan_id = pp.id AND status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_pilot_boat_assignments WHERE plan_id = pp.id AND status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_vehicle_assignments WHERE plan_id = pp.id AND status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') ) ) as confirmedCount,
-- 总分配资源数 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_pilot_assignments WHERE plan_id = pp.id AND status != 'CANCELLED' ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_driver_assignments WHERE plan_id = pp.id AND status != 'CANCELLED' ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_tugboat_assignments WHERE plan_id = pp.id AND status != 'CANCELLED' ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_pilot_boat_assignments WHERE plan_id = pp.id AND status != 'CANCELLED' ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_vehicle_assignments WHERE plan_id = pp.id AND status != 'CANCELLED' ) as totalResourcesCount
FROM pilotage_plans pp
-- 关联船舶表 LEFT JOIN vessels v ON pp.vessel_id = v.id
-- 关联航次表 LEFT JOIN voyages voy ON pp.voyage_id = voy.id
-- 关联代理表 LEFT JOIN agents a ON voy.agent_id = a.id
-- 关联引航员表 LEFT JOIN pilots pilot ON pp.assigned_pilot_id = pilot.id
-- 关联驾驶员表 LEFT JOIN drivers driver ON pp.assigned_driver_id = driver.id
-- 关联车辆表 LEFT JOIN vehicles vehicle ON pp.assigned_vehicle_id = vehicle.id
WHERE 1=1 -- 调度筛选条件：只显示已确认、已发布、进行中的计划
AND pp.plan_status IN
#{status}
AND pp.plan_status = #{params.planStatus}
AND pp.plan_start_time BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate}
AND (v.name_zh LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.vesselName}, '%') OR v.name_en LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.vesselName}, '%'))
AND pp.plan_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.planCode}, '%')
AND pilot.pilot_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.pilotName}, '%')
-- 所有资源已确认（需要在HAVING子句中处理） HAVING confirmedCount = totalResourcesCount
-- 部分资源已确认 HAVING confirmedCount > 0 AND confirmedCount < totalResourcesCount
-- 无资源确认 HAVING confirmedCount = 0
ORDER BY CASE pp.plan_status WHEN 'ONGOING' THEN 1 WHEN 'PUBLISHED' THEN 2 WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, pp.plan_start_time ASC

SELECT -- 计划基本信息 pp.*,
-- 船舶信息 v.*,
-- 航次信息 voy.*,
-- 代理信息 a.*
FROM pilotage_plans pp
-- 关联船舶表 LEFT JOIN vessels v ON pp.vessel_id = v.id
-- 关联航次表 LEFT JOIN voyages voy ON pp.voyage_id = voy.id
-- 关联代理表 LEFT JOIN agents a ON voy.agent_id = a.id
WHERE pp.id = #{planId}
